about_the_game:
Grab your local friend or via Steam Remote Play, build your robots with unique abilities, and prepare yourself for shoot-up with evil robotic armies. All that while receiving (more or less) severe, enraging (or just funny) defects in four original episodes, all packed with stunning hand-drawn visuals and heavy brass music. Fall apart but do not fall back!

TWO ROBOT BUDDIES

Crawlbot and Jetbot are different in terms of playstyle and customization options, but they complement each other. Despite being from low-quality materials and prone to malfunctions.

BUILD THEM UP...

Assemble unique robots from various defects and bonuses parts. Build a powerful but unstable robot or play it safe. Get bigger magazine, active reload ability, support power-ups and many more.

...AND WATCH YOUR ROBOTS FALL APART

All bonuses need to be balanced out with faulty parts in a unique "High risk - High reward" customization. Once your robot is damaged enough, it will start to malfunction. Be prepared for various defects such as friendly fire, nonstop movement, or reloading a random number of bullets.

VARIABLE HAND-DRAWN ENEMIES AND ENVIRONMENTS

Play through four episodes, each consisting of three missions designed to be played in one sitting forming a short story. In every one of them, meet different enemies and experience variable beautiful environments, all created and animated by hand.

HEAVY METALS SOUND LIKE BRASS

How does resistance against the evil robotic government sound like? Like a lot of brass instruments, we say! Listen to the adaptive original soundtrack while fighting with enemies and join the tiny tinny mosh pit.

COMEDIC TOTALITY

We have chosen the most boring topic on the planet Earth - bureaucracy -, added robots, and took it to an absurd extreme, thus forming the brand new genre of comedic totality. Your enemies are vicious, tireless, and armed with suitcases. They stop at nothing. Except for the lunch break, there is no way they are going to miss that.

BECOME A SILICOMRADE AND HELP SAVE INNOCENT LOW-COST ROBOTS!

short_description: Silicomrades is a pencil-drawn co-op shooter for two players with ever-action-changing gameplay as your robots break. Fight against unstoppable bureaucracy while dealing with unique defects mechanic of two malfunctioning robots.
